newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee roasters pause after some buying.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee roasters pause after some buying.

text.p: German coffee consumers were mostly absent from the import market, where they had recently taken advantage of falling prices, traders said.
But they noted some spot and trade buying.
Brazilian and Colombian differentials were steady but Central Americans firmed and Kenyan new main crop prices rose strongly because of high quality.
Outright arabica prices were marked down by $3-4.50 per 50 kg fob on the week in the wake of futures losses, with the exception of Kenyans, which were $9 higher.
Robusta trades included Indonesian and Vietnamese origins.
